rows.note: Use 會 as the all-purpose way to express a future action in the first person.

example.english: We shall go on an outing tomorrow.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 wui5 heoi3 gaau1 jau4

rows.note: Use 應該 when shall expresses obligation or what someone is expected to do.

example.english: You shall submit the report today.
example.jyutping: nei5 gam1 jat6 jing1 goi1 gaau1 fan6 bou3 gou3

rows.note: Use this suggestion pattern for Shall we...? when proposing that A do V.

example.english: Shall we have hot pot tonight?
example.jyutping: bat1 jyu4 ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 sik6 fo2 wo1
